data.display_address: Seagate Building 3, Seagate, Mina Rashid, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present to you this BRAND NEW 2-bedroom residence at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.

The living/dining area is spacious and the big windows let in the beautiful morning sun. Enjoy stunning Burj Khalifa & Sheikh Zayed road skyline views from your private balcony. 

The residence comes fully furnished, kitchen appliances included. The master bedroom features a private balcony and private ensuite bathroom for that extra luxury you deserve.

The apartment:

-2 bedroom (brand new)
-1,157 sq.ft (108 sq.m)
-Fully furnished (kitchen appliances included)
-2 bath
-Burj Khalifa & Open Skyline views
-Laundry/storage room
-2 balconies
-1 basement parking included

Amenities:

-50 meters from seaside promenade
-500-meter canal pool (swimming pool)
-Gym
-24/7 reception & security
-Residence lounge
-Spinneys supermarket on ground floor
-Café`s & restaurants within walking distance (Friends Avenue, Coffee Roasters, Caia Cafe, The Coffee Lab & much more)

Location

-10 min to La Mer/Jumeirah
-10 min to Downtown/DIFC
-15 min to DXB airport

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a waterfront development with its own marina and also features a 500-meter swimming pool for residents. The community has a a variety of restaurants & cafés, offices and much more. And is only a 10-minute drive from the Dubai Mall and La Mer/Jumeirah.

You need a little bit of Rashid Yachts & Marina in your life, Discover Dubai your way at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.
